reference_canvas.space: content area AFTER system SafeArea insets
reference_canvas.scaling: constraint reflow; no screenshot stretch; see RESPONSIVE_AR.md

buttons.feedback: error and success are inline/message states; do not switch to a second incompatible button library

inputs.label: persistent above input
inputs.error: below input; wrap and reflow following controls
inputs.trailing_action: 48dp tap region inside field width, reserved from text; does not extend into neighboring controls

dialogs.small_height: scroll dialog body; keep title and dismissal accessible; no button outside its panel

lists.selection: single selected tab, no hidden automatic navigation

note: PNG/SVG are artwork exports. Repeated local filename aliases have been removed; asset_id and path identify the canonical file.
loading: Source loading shells contain a drawn spinner. The UI should draw one live indicator in this slot, not overlay a second spinner on top. Use the matching disabled shell as backing if needed.
svg_policy: SVG is an editable visual source; some existing shells contain gradients and Gaussian blur filters. Compare rendered output to supplied PNG and use PNG fallback when the target renderer does not reproduce the effect. No package-specific rendering compatibility is claimed.

notification_list_row.text: 1 title + 2 body lines with semantic expandable content
notification_list_row.rtl: list direction reverses; game artwork not mirrored

native_notification.scope: OS chrome not part of Flutter app widget
native_notification.brand_asset: 00_SHARED/branding/exports/store/PuzzleQuest_AppIcon_512x512.png; OS built app icon for real notification; small Android monochrome icon pending production test
native_notification.payload_security: never expose PII on lock screen

admin_schedule.scope: ADM12 final PN01-PN04 policies; per-player IANA local time with UTC storage; 2 per rolling 24h, quiet 22:00-08:00; max six-hour grace
admin_schedule.format: UTC persisted; local-time scheduling policy pending owner
